content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to SQL and Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Creating, Altering, and Deleting Tables
    - Lesson 3: Basic Data Manipulation: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
    - Lesson 4: Retrieving Data: SELECT Statement Basics
    - Lesson 5: Filtering Data with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 6: Ordering Results with ORDER BY Clause
    - Lesson 7: Joining Tables: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, OUTER Joins
    - Lesson 8: Basic Aggregations: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX
    - Lesson 9: GROUP BY Clause for Advanced Aggregations
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Subqueries and Self-Joins

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Python Setup and Basics: Variables, Data Types, and Loops
    - Lesson 2: Importing Libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib
    - Lesson 3: Handling Datasets with Pandas DataFrames
    - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning Techniques: Missing Values, Duplicates, and Outliers
    - Lesson 5: Grouping and Aggregating Data with Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Manipulating Time-Series Data with Pandas
    - Lesson 7: Filtering and Sorting Data using Boolean Indexing
    - Lesson 8: Visualizing Data with Matplotlib: Bar Charts, Line Charts, Scatter Plots
    - Lesson 9: Interactive Data Visualization with Bokeh or Plotly
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Data Wrangling and Preprocessing

   Track: Excel for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Excel Fundamentals: Spreadsheets, Formulas, Functions
    - Lesson 2: Pivot Tables and PivotCharts
    - Lesson 3: Conditional Formatting and Filtering
    - Lesson 4: Data Validation and Error Handling
    - Lesson 5: Data Cleaning Techniques: Text, Numeric, and Logical Functions
    - Lesson 6: Macros and VBA Programming for Automation
    - Lesson 7: Advanced Excel Functions: INDEX, MATCH, IFERROR, etc.
    - Lesson 8: Using Add-ins like Power Query and Power Pivot
    - Lesson 9: Data Visualization with Charts and Tables in Excel
    - Lesson 10: Creating Dashboards using Excel's Web App (Excel for the web)

   Track: Statistics for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Probability Distributions
    - Lesson 2: Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion
    - Lesson 3: Descriptive Statistics: Mean, Median, Mode, Variance, Standard Deviation
    - Lesson 4: Inferential Statistics: Hypothesis Testing, t-Tests, Chi-Square Tests
    - Lesson 5: Correlation and Regression Analysis
    - Lesson 6: Probability Distributions: Normal Distribution, Binomial Distribution, Poisson Distribution
    - Lesson 7: Confidence Intervals and Hypothesis Testing for Proportions
    - Lesson 8: One-Way ANOVA and Two-Way ANOVA
    - Lesson 9: Multiple Linear Regression Analysis
    - Lesson 10: Time Series Analysis and Forecasting

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values: Imputation, Deletion, and Detection
    - Lesson 2: Outlier Detection and Treatment
    - Lesson 3: Duplicate Records Removal and Merging Techniques
    - Lesson 4: Data Normalization and Scaling Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Handling Categorical Variables using One-Hot Encoding
    - Lesson 6: Feature Engineering for Data Enhancement
    - Lesson 7: Data Balancing in Imbalanced Classification Problems
    - Lesson 8: Splitting Datasets into Training, Validation, and Test Sets
    - Lesson 9: Handling Text Data with Natural Language Processing (NLP) Techniques
    - Lesson 10: Preprocessing for Time Series Analysis and Forecasting
